editingGuide: Edit this file and return it for the weekly update. No website code is needed.
Keep version at 1. Set lastUpdated to YYYY-MM-DD. Events appear in file order.
Keep existing IDs unchanged. New IDs must be unique lowercase words joined by hyphens.
description is a list of paragraphs: the first is the preview; the rest expand into the full story.
tags are categories. Reuse consistent spelling; new tags automatically become filters.
images is a list of objects: {"url":"https://your-image-url","alt":"Describe the image","caption":"Optional credit or context"}. Use already hosted images or existing /assets/ paths.
videos is a list of normal YouTube links. Do not paste iframe HTML or upload video files.
sources is a list of HTTPS reference links. Leave unavailable images, videos or sources as empty arrays.
Preserve factual accuracy and image credits. Do not invent missing historical details.

events.title: Leeewith3Es Starts 6b9t.org
description: On March 3, 2019, Leeewith3Es launched 6b9t.org with a new map. This was an earlier server that later used the 6b6t.org domain.

events.title: 6b9t Rebrands to 6b6t.org
description: On June 25, 2019, 6b9t rebranded to 6b6t.org to avoid sounding like a joke.

events.title: 1st Incursion
description: The 1st incursion took place in July 2019.
Taiwanese players join the server in large numbers, and the player count surpasses 50.

events.title: Server Resets After Hard Disk Failure
description: In November 2019, the server reset following a hard disk failure.
This is the first of many map resets in the early history of 6b6t.

events.title: Server Resets After Region Files Corrupt
description: In December 2019, the server reset again after its region files became corrupted.

events.title: The Chunk Dupe Is Active
description: In April 2020, the Chunk Dupe was active on the server.

events.title: The WWE Donkey Dupe Is Active
description: From June 11 until November 2020, the WWE Donkey Dupe was active on the server.

events.title: 2nd Incursion
description: An influx of Spanish players occurs after MrCramYT makes a video about the server.
MrCramYT made a video about 6b6t that gained around 23,000 views, leading many Spanish players to join the server. The video has since been deleted due to drama surrounding the admins at the time.

events.title: bleepo Sells the 6b6t.org Domain
description: On December 1, 2020, bleepo sold the 6b6t.org domain to JJ for $5k.
JJ, the admin of 9b9t, later sold the domain to qbasty.

events.title: The Llama Dupe Is Active
description: From January 1 until May 2021, the Llama Dupe was active on 6b6t/7b7t.

events.title: Leee Launches 7b7t
description: On January 31, 2021, Leee launched 7b7t.me using an August 19, 2020 backup of the earlier 6b6t map.

events.title: Birth of 6b6t
description: Started by qbasty on January 16th, 2022, 6b6t immediately gained traction as the 1.12.2 anarchy server with /tpa and /home.
qbasty launched a new anarchy server under the domain 6b6t.org, starting the 6b6t that exists today.

events.title: The Item Frame Dupe Is Active
description: From the server's launch on January 16 until August 19, 2022, the Item Frame Dupe was active on 6b6t.

events.title: TheTroll2001 Finds an Authentication Exploit
description: On January 22, 2022, the player TheTroll2001 found an authentication exploit on 6b6t.

events.title: Acquisitions
description: During the third month of its existence, 6b6t acquired 7b7t, which was about to shut down. The maps were merged together and history was saved.
The merge brought thousands of illegal items onto 6b6t.

events.title: 3rd Incursion
description: A coordinated raid group effort to grief the overworld spawn further, held in March 2022.

The incursion (referred to as the 1st incursion on qbasty's version of 6b6t) was planned in three phases: griefing the 2k-by-2k area around spawn, digging a trench around that area, and building an obsidian outpost at spawn.

Groups including Imperium and PSG_YT's Skilled Crafters took part, led by notnotironboy and PSG_YT. Only the first phase was completed before the trench was left unfinished; the outpost was postponed to the 4th Incursion two months later.

events.title: Pistonmaster Nukes the 7b7t Discord
description: On May 5, 2022, Pistonmaster banned everyone from the 7b7t Discord server.

events.title: 4th Incursion
description: A follow-up raid on the overworld spawn held on May 19, 2022, meant to finish what the 3rd Incursion had left unfinished.

Also called the 2nd incursion on qbasty's version of 6b6t, it brought together several raid groups, including Imperium, Imperials, Eternals, and PSG_YT's Skilled Crafters, under leaders such as notnotironboy, tanishisherewith, PSG_YT, SankuOG, and c1yd3i.

Unlike the 3rd Incursion, this one succeeded: obsidian walls were built around spawn at the 4k mark, an outpost was completed, lag machines were placed, spawn was griefed within a 2k radius, and players were killed at spawn.

events.title: Colonizadores Join From 2b2t
description: Colonizadores joined 6b6t from 2b2t in July 2022.

events.title: The 2022 Backdoor
description: c1yd3i (not the same c1yd3i from 2b2t) backdoors 6b6t around July or August 2022, resulting in a wave of newly created illegal items.
How c1yd3i's illegal items actually got onto the server was never made public.

events.title: The Donkey Dupe Is Active
description: On August 19, 2022, the Donkey Dupe became active on 6b6t, around the time the Item Frame Dupe stopped working.

events.title: Shulkergang Founded
description: Shulkergang, a clan built around a gimmick of wearing shulker boxes using the /head command, was founded on October 6, 2022 by 28st, kokos_odpadnem, and schmiddie.

28st had previously been a member of LagGang, where he met kokos_odpadnem, who introduced him to duping and supplied him with kits. The idea for a shulker-themed clan came from 28st and led directly to Shulkergang's creation.

events.title: No Anti-Cheat Event
description: The first ever event during which the anti-cheat was disabled on 6b6t, allowing for uncontrolled chaos and player activity for over 48 hours.

events.title: Colonizadores Create the Largest Spawn Logo
description: In October 2022, Colonizadores create the largest spawn logo.

events.title: Xymb Joins the Admin Team
description: Xymb joined the admin team by the December 2022 upgrade to MultiPaper.

events.title: 6b6t Updates To 1.19.2
description: 6b6t becomes the first anarchy server to upgrade to 1.19 thanks to the experimental software MultiPaper. 2b2t took over a year longer to upgrade.
The upgrade to 1.19.2 was made possible thanks to Xymb.

events.title: Premium Accounts No Longer Require a Password
description: On December 17, 2022, premium accounts stopped requiring a password. Until then, any premium account could be registered as a cracked account; afterward, premium accounts were treated as premium accounts.

events.title: The LagGang Dupe Is Active
description: In December 2022, following the switch to MultiPaper, the LagGang Dupe was active on 6b6t.

events.title: IKEA Clan Is Founded
description: The IKEA clan was founded on January 1, 2023.

events.title: IKEA V2 Dupe Is Active
description: On January 31, 2023, the IKEA V2 dupe was active. IKEA was a clan founded to find exploits and dupes on the MultiPaper server software.

events.title: IKEA V5 Dupe Is Active
description: On May 8, 2023, the IKEA V5 dupe was active.

events.title: Lack Of Growth
description: 6b6t experiences the only period when the average player count was around 30. There is no growth without challenges.

events.title: Switching to Folia
description: 6b6t updates to 1.19.4 thanks to another piece of software called Folia, which brings more stability and performance to the server, resuming the growth.

events.title: The 555 Is Founded
description: The 555 is founded in June 2023.

events.title: IKEA Discover the Godmode Exploit
description: In mid 2023, the IKEA clan discovers the godmode exploit.

events.title: 5th Incursion
description: On July 24, 2023, TheHorizonMc streamed on 6b6t, which prompted the 5th incursion. Incursion members tried to hunt him down, but he escaped spawn.

events.title: First 300+ Player Record
description: The server reaches 300+ players for the first time, without any queue, making this a historic achievement for both the marketing efforts of 6b6t and the development team.

events.title: Invisibility, Authentication and Teleport Exploits Discovered
description: Invisibility, authentication and teleport exploits are discovered in late 2023.

events.title: Christmas Event
description: A month-long Christmas event with daily quests, bringing the community together and offering new fun ways to spend time on the server.

events.title: 104 Is Founded
description: 104 is founded and begins the atlas project.

events.title: The Highway Men Begin Their Work
description: The Highway Men (THM) begin repairing and expanding highways.

events.title: Saviors Is Founded
description: Saviors is founded in mid 2024.

events.title: The Chunk Dupe Gets Patched
description: In August 2024, the Chunk Dupe was patched.

events.title: Update to 1.21.1
description: The server updates to 1.21.1 on September 13th, 2024, under new software called "Abomination", a major version leap.

events.title: 6th Incursion
description: From September 21 to 28, 2024, the 6th incursion was held in response to the Turkish streamer olimpos streaming on 6b6t.

events.title: Hidden Admin Dupes
description: The 6b6t team, for a period of a few months, experiments with adding hidden dupes and letting players discover them.

events.title: Christmas Build Competition
description: Another build competition is held on 6b6t, likely the most popular. The results are shown in a video on our YouTube channel. Click here to watch the video.

events.title: Illegals Event
description: A rare 48-hour illegals event takes place on the server, creating a unique experience for those online.

events.title: Autism Inc Logs Into qbasty's Account
description: On March 12, 2025, the group Autism Inc used an authentication exploit to log in to qbasty's account.

events.title: Dupe Patch
description: The last known admin-added dupe was patched, resolving a significant issue.

events.title: New Build Competition
description: A new build competition themed around Ancient Civilizations was started, encouraging creativity and community participation.

events.title: Dyselexia Is Founded
description: Dyselexia is founded on May 14, 2025.

events.title: All-Time Player High
description: 6b6t reaches a brand new all-time record of 580 players online at the same time without a queue.

Admins added the item frame dupe. The dupe worked like this: players would place a shulker in an item frame and right-click it a few times. Eventually, the item would duplicate when taken out of the item frame. The dupe was active for 24 hours and only had a minor impact on the server economy compared to other earlier and later dupes.
The team announces that 6b6t supporting 1000 players online without a queue is soon going to become a reality.

events.title: NCR Is Founded
description: NCR is founded in June 2025.

events.title: 6b6t Updates to 1.21.7
description: On July 29, 2025, 6b6t updated to 1.21.7.

events.title: Cosmical Is Founded
description: Cosmical is founded in July 2025.

events.title: Saviors Disbanded
description: Saviors disbanded on August 13, 2025.

events.title: The Boatgate Incident
description: On August 30, 2025, Xymb added a community-made BoatFly patch by IEatHex_, resulting in the Boatgate incident.

events.title: New Rank
description: 6b6t adds the Legend Rank, the next upgrade from Apex.

events.title: Dropping Heads Event
description: For 72 hours, players would drop their heads when killed. The server reaches a new player record of 700.

events.title: Christmas Lobby Added
description: On December 1, 2025, 6b6t added a Christmas lobby made by Volizray.

events.title: Admin Dupes
description: The 6b6t team adds several dupes during Christmas.

events.title: 72-Hour Dupe Event
description: On December 27, 2025, a 72-hour-long dupe event was held, during which Xymb tested his new Multi-Abomination software.

events.title: The Oldest Anarchy Server in Hytale
description: 6b6t launches an Anarchy Server on Hytale, a Minecraft alternative, making it the oldest Anarchy Server in Hytale.
The server is hosted at hytale.6b6t.org.

events.title: 2026 April Fools Event
description: From April 1 to 4, 2026, the April Fools event saw crystals becoming placeable, ElytraFly getting patched, and teleporting requiring a hoe.

events.title: 2026 Nether Roof Event
description: From April 24 to 28, 2026, the Nether Roof Event was held.

events.title: 6b6t Updates to 1.21.11
description: On May 30, 2026, 6b6t updated to 1.21.11.

events.title: 6b6t Updates to 26.1
description: On July 1, 2026, 6b6t updated to 26.1.

events.title: 6b6t Updates to 26.2
description: On July 7, 2026, 6b6t updated to 26.2.

events.title: Mojang Bans 6b6t
description: The server is now blacklisted by Mojang. Players now require AnarchyMod to continue playing.

events.title: New Player Record
description: During the Summer Dupe event, 6b6t reached over 1,155 players online at once without a queue, according to the official server announcement.
The Summer Dupe event ran from August 14 to 24.

events.title: The Horizon Invasion
description: The Horizon (TheHorizonMc), a Minecraft-anarchy YouTuber, invaded the server with his fans. Players could choose to either protect or hunt The Horizon.
This was the 7th incursion, occurring after he streamed the server for the second time.

events.title: Mojang Issues DMCA Against AnarchyMod
description: On September 17, 2026, Mojang issued a DMCA takedown notice against AnarchyMod on GitHub.

events.title: Largest Creations
description: Players continue to develop extraordinary creations on the server, such as the largest map art, called "big owo", by fizzfluff or the largest spawn logo made by the 555.
